scope: Preserve the opt-in native session-close reclamation engineering baseline and remaining application changes on local main; no new GPU experiment.

engine.launch_limit: Existing launchers require HEAD94602c9 and the canonical staging patch. Prepare and qualify a separate combined candidate before registering a GPU run.

implementation.reclaim: Existing retirement checks reject live/shared references, locks, children, in-flight transfers, reused node identities and stale generations.
implementation.retry: Bounded FIFO at native HiCache safe points; lock release only marks readiness. Late-finishing closed requests are queued after cache cleanup.
implementation.telemetry: Copy optional engine counters at the existing once-per-second Host snapshot; omit absent engine evidence.

validation.preserved_evidence_format: The original V1204 pytest failure XML contains traceback trailing whitespace. Its bytes and SHA256 are preserved; it is the only diff-check exclusion.

initial_engine_attempt.reason: The late-finished-request test fixture lacked kv.swa_evicted_seqlen. The fixture was corrected and the original failing XML retained.

benchmark.scope: Real CPU cache fixture; only explicit-close calls timed, excluding construction and insertion. GC performs additional physical release; different-work costs are not isolated speedup, GPU DMA or JCT.

limits: Simple engineering baseline, not a claimed new paper contribution.
CPU qualification is limited to single-rank HiCache FULL and FULL+Mamba paths.
No GPU throughput, workflow JCT, quality or all-run overhead result exists for this candidate.
No new GPU experiment, application worktree, registration or quality queue is created by this integration.
Frozen V75/V76 application worktrees, engine and registered helpers are unchanged.
Independent paper generators and assets remain outside this system-code integration.
